title: The Late Bakery Revisited
author: E. M. Fairweather
blurb: Freya Brightwater, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
